record_status: coordinator-audit for the Linux oo-mysql-doctor release build (plan S6-B-01)

package.name: openssl
package.ecosystem: native C library (source tarball, not a Rust crate)
manifests: ci/cli.Dockerfile (native build: static libssl/libcrypto, zig cc -target <arch>-linux-gnu.2.31)
deploy/lite/mysql-doctor/Cargo.toml (openssl-sys 0.9.117 via oo-connectors feature mysql -> mysql_async native-tls-tls; OPENSSL_DIR/OPENSSL_STATIC=1 on Linux only)

obligations: Ship the Apache-2.0 license text with the Linux npm binaries (packages/cli/licenses/native/openssl-3.5.9-LICENSE.txt, emitted into THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt by packages/cli/scripts/licenses.py).

features_enabled: Configure linux-<arch> no-shared no-dso no-engine no-tests no-docs
package.msrv: not a Rust crate; no MSRV impact

reason: The Linux npm release cross-builds with cargo-zigbuild against a glibc 2.31 floor. oo-mysql-doctor reaches OpenSSL through mysql_async native-tls-tls (the MySQL TLS backend of oo-connectors, unchanged). Linking the build image's system libssl would break the ABI floor and add a runtime libssl3 dependency, so the doctor links a pinned static OpenSSL built with the same zig sysroot. Scope: Linux oo-mysql-doctor in the npm tarball only; macOS uses Security.framework, and the lite image build (deploy/lite/Dockerfile) is unchanged.

advisory.scanner: manual review of the OpenSSL vulnerability list and secadv/20261110.txt on 2026-11-13
advisory.evidence: 3.5.9 fixes the 2026-09-29 advisory set. secadv/20261110.txt lists five Low issues (CVE-2026-88822, CVE-2026-88823, CVE-2026-95691, CVE-2026-95692, CVE-2026-107496) fixed in 3.5.10, which is not yet published on the source page or as a GitHub tag. None is on the doctor's path: QUIC and CMS are unused and AES-GCM-SIV is not a TLS cipher suite. Move to 3.5.10 once it clears the seven-day floor.
